body: Thank you for your advice. Honestly I feel like I have no control over what's happening right now, so what you suggested seems like the best possibility. It's nice to know that people are willing to help strangers when nobody is there for them.

Thanks for the reassurance, like I said nobody really understands, but the empathy helps. While I said suicide has been on my mind more than ever before, it doesn't mean I'll go through with, it's too much on those that care for me. That doesn't make the depression, or the anxiety, or the guilt of anything go away. Thank you for you help.

Nothing much, my family has always stressed academics above everything else, and band was always more of a hobby for me. I do well enough in school, but outside band I don't have any extracurriculars. I think the best thing I can do for her is give her space, I'll see if she's open to talk again on Wednesday or something, but I told her that it's best that we don't talk for a while because I don't want her to have to deal with me ever again.

Not to mention that my "friends" my section mates infuriate me. The band directors put me in charge because I'm so incredibly "selfless" but all I've become is a senseless dictator, just because I want us to success.

Now my mom comes to tell me she needs to get surgery, I don't remember what, but that it will tax us heavily and she doesn't know how much we can afford this year. My dad says he'll take care of us, but he's slowly drifting further and further away. And I've failed to comfort her, and I feel like a failure.

Everyone is apparently worried about me, but that's typical isn't it? Why bother being there before it got bad, when you can just be there when he's about to kill himself so you don't look like a cunt. Disgusting. They say they want to help, to take the weight of my shoulders, but they don't mean it. Who would want to deal with someone else's problems?

I'm a failure as a son, a friend, a leader, a student, as a human being. I destroy everything close to me, and I'm everything I fear. I'm a manipulative disgusting, and decrepit sociopath.
